name: ForceHub – Codeforces to GitHub
description: Automatically push your Accepted Codeforces submissions to GitHub — including contest-time solves. Reliable sync, deep insights, zero copy-pasting.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; connect-src https://codeforces.com https://api.github.com https://firestore.googleapis.com https://*.workers.dev; img-src 'self' data: https:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src https://fonts.gstatic.com;
